title: Set uploaded hero background image and enforce autoplaying looping background music + memory grids behavior

requirements.text: Add the user-uploaded image (1770099054248.png) as the default Hero section background so it displays immediately when no hero background has been uploaded via the Media Manager.

quotes: Add this image as background in hero section

acceptanceCriteria: On a fresh load (no hero uploaded in the app), the Hero section background renders using the provided image.
If a hero background has been uploaded via the existing Media Manager flow, the uploaded hero background overrides the default image.
The image is bundled as a static frontend asset (not served via the backend).

requirements.text: Update the background music player to satisfy the HARD RULES: background audio autoplays silently on page load, loops continuously, uses a user-provided MP3 uploaded via the Media Manager, shows only a small bottom-right player popup with play/pause control, and keeps a lightly visible audio tag on-screen; remove any UI that implies required user interaction (e.g., “tap to start” prompts).

quotes:
BACKGROUND MUSIC (HARD RULE):
- Background audio must autoplay silently on page load with play and pause button in down most right corner 
Use customised song in MP3 
- Audio should loop continuously
- just the player popup
- NO user interaction required
- Audio tag must be shown lightly
- Mobile autoplay compatible

acceptanceCriteria: When a song is present (songUrl exists), the audio element is configured for mobile-friendly autoplay behavior by starting muted and attempting playback automatically on page load.
Audio loops continuously.
A play/pause control is fixed at the bottom-right of the viewport and remains usable on mobile.
The <audio> element is lightly visible (not fully hidden) while still matching the popup style.
No “tap to start” or similar prompt is shown to the user.

requirements.text: Ensure the Image Memory section renders a responsive grid of 43 image cards driven by the existing slot configuration, with each card clickable/tappable to perform a smooth 3D rotate/flip and fade-in romantic message reveal on the back; keep soft shadow and rounded corners.

quotes:
IMAGE MEMORY SECTION:
- Grid of image cards of 43 images(I can add unlimited images)
-add images before publishing 
- Each image card must be clickable
- On tap ROTATE + FADE MESSAGE (ROMANTIC SURPRISE) in 3d smooth form 
  - Back side shows a romantic message text
- Smooth rotation animation
- Soft shadow and rounded corners

acceptanceCriteria: The Image Memory section displays 43 slots by default in a grid layout that adapts from mobile to desktop.
Tapping/clicking a populated card flips/rotates in 3D and the message fades in on the back side.
Cards have rounded corners and a soft shadow in both front and back states.
Empty slots display an English empty-state message (existing behavior is acceptable).

requirements.text: In “working mode” (Media Manager), provide clear, mobile-friendly per-image-slot controls to add/replace images, open the drag/zoom adjust UI, reorder (drag where supported), and save/submit changes so updates appear in the Image Memory grid after submitting/publishing.

quotes: * Show add or replace button and also drag to adjust option and save button in working mode

acceptanceCriteria: For each image slot, the Media Manager UI exposes Add/Replace and Adjust controls without requiring hover.
Users can reorder image slots using drag-and-drop where supported and/or existing alternative controls for mobile.
After the user clicks the existing primary submit/save action in the Media Manager, the Image Memory grid reflects the changes without requiring a page refresh.

requirements.text: Ensure the Video Memory section renders a grid of 6 videos with preserved aspect ratio, supports adding/replacing videos via the Media Manager before publishing, and keeps the existing mobile-friendly playback configuration (playsInline, looping, default-muted).

quotes:
Video Memory Section :
 - grid of videos as it is the ratio 6 videos by adding videos before publishing

acceptanceCriteria: The Video Memory section shows exactly 6 slots.
Uploaded videos render with consistent aspect ratio handling across the grid.
Videos can be added/replaced through the existing Media Manager flow and appear after submit/publish.
Videos remain mobile-friendly (playsInline) and loop continuously.

requirements.text: Add the newly bundled hero background image to the frontend assets and reference it consistently from the Hero section (and/or media store defaulting logic) without routing it through the backend.

quotes: Add this image as background in hero section

acceptanceCriteria: The image file is stored under frontend/public/assets/generated and loaded via a static URL.
No backend API calls are required to display the default hero background.

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; do not introduce additional backend services.
Do not edit any files under frontend/src/components/ui or any paths listed in frontend.immutablePaths.
All user-facing text must be in English (except user-provided content already embedded in the hero text).
nonGoals: Fixing the platform/internal deployment configuration error (this requires Caffeine platform intervention).
Adding third-party auth providers, external databases, or non-Internet-Identity login methods.
Adding real-time features (WebSockets/chat) or external media hosting integrations.

required: Watercolor-style couple illustration with pink floral background and title text (hero-bg.dim_736x964.png)
